name: localaitab
description: On-demand local FIM completion and selection refactoring, backed by Ollama.

commands.title: LocalAITab: Switch Between Manual and Automatic

enumDescriptions: Only suggest when explicitly asked (Cmd+K A / Ctrl+K A).

localAITab.model.description: Completion model. Must be a FIM-capable *base* model.

localAITab.debounceMs.description: Idle time before firing a request. Ignored in manual mode.

localAITab.prefixChars.description: Chars of context before the cursor.

localAITab.suffixChars.description: Chars of context after the cursor.

localAITab.multiline.description: auto = multi-line unless real code follows the cursor.

localAITab.neighborFiles.description: Include other open tabs as repo-level FIM context.

localAITab.neighborBudget.description: Total chars borrowed from neighbor files.

localAITab.keepAlive.description: Keeps models resident in Ollama between requests.

localAITab.timeoutMs.description: Abort a completion that takes longer than this. Cold model loads can take a second or two.

localAITab.refactorModel.description: Model used for Refactor Selection, Chat, Agent and Search planning. Must be an *instruct* model, not a base model.

localAITab.refactorModelFallbacks.description: Ordered instruct models to offer when refactorModel is not installed on this machine. The first one that is installed is proposed; if none are, the largest installed instruct (non -base) model is proposed. You are always asked before a substitute is used.

localAITab.refactorPreview.description: Show a before/after diff before applying a refactor.

localAITab.refactorContextChars.description: Chars of surrounding file sent with the selection. 0 disables.

enumDescriptions: Selection only. Fastest, no surrounding code.
A window of characters either side of the selection (localAITab.refactorContextChars).
The whole current file, with the selection marked.
The whole current file plus other open tabs of the same language.
localAITab.refactorContext.description: How much context refactor and improve commands send to the model.

localAITab.refactorNeighborBudget.description: Chars borrowed from other open tabs when refactorContext is "openTabs".

localAITab.verifyAttempts.description: How many times Make This Better may feed its own errors back to the model to repair them. 0 disables repair.

localAITab.verifyTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the language server to republish diagnostics after an edit.

localAITab.chatModel.description: Model for the chat panel. Empty falls back to localAITab.refactorModel. Must be an instruct model.

localAITab.chatHistoryTurns.description: Conversation turns kept before the oldest are dropped.

localAITab.skillPaths.description: Folders holding skills, one subfolder with a SKILL.md per skill. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace; ~ is your home directory. Earlier entries win when two skills share a name. A skills.json beside a folder (e.g. .localaitab/skills.json) can reference skills kept elsewhere, such as Claude Code's, without copying them: {"skills": ["~/.agents/skills/tdd", {"path": "~/.claude/skills/review", "model": false}]}. "model": false keeps a skill out of the model's list; it still runs as /name.

localAITab.extraFolders.markdownDescription: Folders outside the workspace that agent mode may read, search and stage edits in, as absolute paths or starting with `~/`. User settings only, so a repository's own settings cannot grant itself access to your files. `/allow` in the chat grants a folder until the panel closes.

localAITab.chatThinking.description: Allow reasoning models to think before answering in chat. Slower, sometimes better.

localAITab.agentMaxSteps.description: Hard cap on tool-calling steps in agent mode. The loop stops here regardless of what the model wants.

localAITab.agentMaxReadChars.description: Maximum characters read_file returns before truncating.

localAITab.agentMaxSearchLines.description: Maximum match lines the search tool returns.

localAITab.operatorMaxSteps.description: Hard cap on tool-calling steps in operator mode. Higher than agent mode, since a run can edit, build and fix in a loop.

localAITab.operatorCommandTimeout.description: Seconds an operator-mode shell command may run before it is killed.

localAITab.operatorMaxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters of a command's output handed back to the model. The head and tail are kept.

localAITab.planGlobs.description: Default ripgrep glob for search planning.

localAITab.planMaxSymbols.description: Identifiers sampled from the codebase and shown to the planner. Raising this improves query quality on large or unusually-named projects.

localAITab.planContextLines.description: Lines of surrounding code attached either side of a ticked hit.

localAITab.chatContextPercent.description: Share of the running context window that attached context may use. The rest is left for the conversation and the reply. Ignored when chatContextTokens is set.

localAITab.chatContextTokens.description: Absolute token cap on attached context. 0 derives it from chatContextPercent and the model’s running window.

scripts.test: node test/check.js && node test/session-format.js && node test/markdown.js && node test/commands.js && node test/skills.js && node test/workspace-paths.js && node test/access.js && node test/conversation.js && node test/tui-editor.js && node test/tui-parts.js && node test/transcripts.js && node test/live.js
